title: Las Mañanitas
attribution: Traditional Mexican birthday serenade from the 19th century. The arrangers sometimes credited with fixing its modern form, Manuel M. Ponce (died 1948), Alfonso Esparza Oteo (died 1950) and Alejandro Manzo (died 1950), all died before 1956, so melody and words are public domain. Melody checked against the score in the Wikipedia article (transposed from A to G).
